decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design, Access and Heritage Statement, 1127/PL.01, 1127/PL.04 Rev. A, 1127/PL.07 Rev. A Received: 25 July 2014) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - All hard and soft landscape works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.  The works shall be carried out prior to the occupation of any part of the development or in accordance with the programme agreed with the local planning authority

Condition : 6 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the
site except between the hours of 0800 to 1800 on Mondays
to Friday and 0800 to 1300 on Saturdays and none shall
take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - The basement shall at no time be used or occupied as a
separate dwelling independent of the main house and shall not be used as sleeping accommodation.

Condition : 8 - No development shall be carried out until a Construction Method Statement, which is certified by an engineer, giving specific details of excavation, temporary works and construction techniques, including details of potential impacts on neighbouring land based on an assessment of the geology and hydrology of the area has been submitted to and been approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 9 - No development shall be carried out until such time as the
person carrying out the work is a member of the Considerate
Constructors Scheme and its code of practice, and the
details of the membership and contact details are clearly
displayed on the site so that they can be easily read by members of the public.
description: Variation of Condition 2 (approved plans) to amend patio levels, lightwell and roof window following planning permission 00567/60/P8 dated 25.10.2013 for erection of a two storey side extension, ground floor rear extension, new front porch, installation of 2 front velux roof windows, side chimney addition, two rear roof dormers and a basement extension
